work_packages.success: Exact citation/theorem dependency graph with claim locations, hypotheses, conclusions, applicability, and one of the four governed evidence dispositions for every material node.
A checked theorem-grade closure of one material convergence implication, or a sharp reduction identifying the smallest additional hypothesis/source lemma needed.
An exact hidden-assumption/counterexample audit of the proposed upgrade from qualified source claim to theorem-grade fixed-IR UV construction.

minimum_inputs: one source-dependency return or exact source blocker
one adversarial return or exact adversarial blocker
synthesis_gate.promotion_rule: No external result is canonical until GCL independently replays or verifies the material claim and merges a protected Solve synthesis.
synthesis_gate.next_action_if_consistent: Select the smallest confirmed MISSING_THEOREM_GRADE_PROOF node and open a bounded native proof/falsification tranche.
synthesis_gate.next_action_if_inconsistent: Protect the disagreement as evidence, identify the exact conflicting premise, and resolve before theorem promotion.

pre_synthesis_replay.WP-B: conditional finite-order Slavnov limit passage independently replayed against MRS Sect. VIII
pre_synthesis_replay.WP-C: typed topology/domain/uniformity objection independently replayed as logically material

claim_boundary: This registry allocates independent support work only. It does not authorize certification, canonical claim mutation, source admission, or cross-route composition.
